rows.note: Use 劫案 as the ordinary noun for a robbery case or crime.

example.english: This robbery case has left the whole street on edge.
example.traditional: 呢宗劫案搞到成條街都人心惶惶。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 gip3 on3 gaau2 dou3 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 jan4 sam1 wong4 wong4

rows.note: Use 搶劫 as a noun when referring to the act or practice of robbing itself rather than a particular case.

example.english: Robbery isn't a way to make quick money; it's a crime.
example.traditional: 搶劫唔係搵快錢，係犯法。
example.jyutping: coeng2 gip3 m4 hai6 wan2 faai3 cin2 hai6 faan6 faat3
